purpose: Additional atlas and mission-context surface maps; source gaps retained.
common_limits: These mosaics combine multiple acquisitions and are not observations at a single mission-playback clock time.
Global means map footprint, not complete observed detail. Preserve black source gaps or label them explicitly as unmapped; never imply that black pixels are measured dark surface.
Image mosaics contain source shading and seams, so they should not be presented as calibrated albedo or fresh uniformly detailed observations.
Longitude conventions differ by body. Use the supplied metadata when orienting the texture; do not assume the seam is the same meridian for every map.
No local edits or image generation were performed.
